title: Consistency of the sample solver
statement: Let $n,\ell,m$ be natural numbers and choose $m$ samples in $\{0,1\}^n\times\mathbb F_2$. If some degree-at-most-$\ell$ coefficient family satisfies every equation determined by these samples, then the coefficient family returned by the specified solver satisfies every one of those equations.
hypotheses_covered: The sample equations have a satisfying degree-at-most-$\ell$ coefficient family
